description: Review trips using the overnight engine. Explicit trip queries: set includeCandidates:true for lower-confidence candidates; name a trip with destination (e.g. "Copenhagen"); use mode:area with area for every expense in a country or city. Show dates, recorded locations, count and uncertainty; locations are not travel or client proof. Copy exact selections to group_expenses with a user-chosen trip/client name and confirm:false, then request approval. Possible additions stay out unless the user includes them (includePossibleAdditions:true). Merge/deduplicate selections for one destination; separate destinations need separate confirmations. Preserve existing assignments, Personal and read-only rows. Never infer clients or countries from currency. clientEmail mode is read-only.

area.description: Country or city for mode area, e.g. "Denmark" or "Copenhagen, Denmark". Ambiguous places return candidates to ask about.

dateRange.description: Inclusive period to find overlapping trips; returns full trip membership, including boundary dates outside the period.

destination.description: Trip the user named, e.g. "Copenhagen". Several matches return them for clarification; never guess.

includeCandidates.description: Default false: high-confidence only. True: also show uncertain candidates without saving recommendations or changing expenses.

includePossibleAdditions.description: Default false. True only when the user explicitly asks to include the separate possible additions in the selection.

limit.description: Result cap (default 3, max 10), not an exhaustive list; see remaining.

mode.description: episode (default): trips. area: every expense located in the area.

offset.description: Skip this many results to page through remaining trips.

refresh.description: Recheck current recorded expenses for suggested trips; never change their tags.

name: get_trip_suggestions

proposals.description: Read-only trip proposals; accepting one continues through group_expenses.

remaining.description: More matching trips available with a larger offset.
